## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is Anne's imaginary friend, whom [Anne](../character/anne.md) envisions as her own reflection in the glass door of a bookcase. [Anne](../character/anne.md) invents and speaks to Katie during her lonely time living with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), treating the reflection as a comforting companion. The relationship exists entirely within Anne's imagination to provide solace before her arrival at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

- presumed Friend of — imaginary friend and reflection in bookcase door  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)</sub>
